title: Blitzscaling 11: Patrick Collison on Hiring at Stripe and the Role of a Product-Focused CEO
description: This is session 11 of Technology-enabled Blitzscaling, a Stanford University class taught by Reid Hoffman, John Lilly, Allen Blue, and Chris Yeh. This class features John Lilly interviewing Patrick Collison, the Co-Founder of Stripe.
fulltitle: Blitzscaling 11: Patrick Collison on Hiring at Stripe and the Role of a Product-Focused CEO
